description: 资料感知物理仓策略：拆分多逻辑组资料热点，并在相同稳定 owner、模板和权限边界内合并稀疏或空逻辑组；逻辑 ResourceGroup、CourseDescriptor、CurriculumRecord 和 typed route 身份不变。

semantics.resource_unit: 默认一文件一单元；Eclipse SUMO 1.21.0 Windows 便携工具树的 3,265 个文件合为1单元，容量保留全部成员字节。

boundaries.content: full canonical owner; depth < 2 stays dedicated
boundaries.sparse: canonical owner first two fields; depth 0 stays dedicated
boundaries.empty: same safe owner boundary as sparse

semantics.single_group_overflow: allowed; logical group is never split
